claim: The already-proved set-level closure of the native four-mode left ideal extends to a real-linear endomorphism given by left multiplication by the ordered volume element, and that endomorphism is an involution.

carrier.type: Cl44 = CliffordAlgebra splitQ44 and cl44LeftIdealSubmodule = range (LinearMap.mulRight ℝ cl44VacuumIdempotent)
operations: Native associative Clifford multiplication on Cl44
Four-mode vacuum idempotent cl44VacuumIdempotent = (a 0 * adag 0) * (a 1 * adag 1) * (a 2 * adag 2) * (a 3 * adag 3)
conventions: The left ideal is the product range {y * cl44VacuumIdempotent}.
The ordered volume is built from (e₀,e₁,e₂,e₃,f₀,f₁,f₂,f₃) in the native quadratic carrier.
No identification with the separate Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ model is assumed.

consumers: Proposed future consumer: a native volume-action component in a Cl(4,4) ideal representation. No current downstream consumer is asserted.

smallest_gap.description: The owner already proves closure of the generated left ideal under arbitrary left multiplication at the set level. The missing increment is to package native volume multiplication as a real-linear endomorphism of the range submodule and prove its square is identity using volumeElement_sq.

out_of_scope: Dimension or minimality of the native ideal
An explicit 16-state Fock basis or occupation-number model
An intertwiner with the separate matrix Cl(4,4) model or its SemiSpinorPlus/SemiSpinorMinus submodules
A split-sedenion derivation action or physical interpretation
